en: Round multi‑view color postcard with an orange background and four photographic views of a historic Hungarian city. The images show old fortress walls and towers, a large Romanesque cathedral with four towers, and a central square with historic buildings and a domed structure. In the middle is the city coat of arms featuring a stylized castle wall with a red star and an emblem below. The reverse side has standard postcard layout with address lines and stamp box, printed mostly in Hungarian.
